needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Extend and widen the footway to at least 1.5m and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles or other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install physical barriers to prevent vehicles from parking on the footway.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without refuge on a wide road
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: crossing is hard to see and obstructed
needed.suggestion: Install high-visibility crossing signs and ensure the crossing is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to aid accessibility for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: street lighting is insufficient in an urban area
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.
